# Normalize socket type after discovery, while allowing autodetect in the edit form

AccountConfig.validateSocketType accepts 0, 1, 2 and 3 with fallback 0; outgoing updateFields also allows -1 as the editing autodetect sentinel. The current manual controller probes a copied config, normalizes the result, and reflects returned settings in the subview. Keep unresolved edit values separate from a tested configuration. No actual connection or encryption result was verified. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.

Scope: Account Hub discovered settings.
